name: 4-track Music Box
description: A music box on cassette tape at normal and half speed, layering the original pitch an octave below

name: 4-track Glockenspiel
description: A glockenspiel on cassette tape at normal and half speed, so every note also plays an octave down

name: 4-track Toy Piano
description: A Kalikå Leksakspiano on cassette tape at normal and half speed, playable an octave down

name: EDB-Orgel
description: Four digital synthesis types with the workflow of a drawbar organ crossed with an analog synth

name: Elektrisk Salmesykkel
description: A Yamaha L-20D electric harmonium with tremulant, noise and reverb, and an air supply that sags as more notes are held

name: Lo-fi Tape Piano
description: A Louis Zwicki Pianette recorded to cassette through three microphones, with tape compression, wow and flutter

name: MaskinTrommer
description: Electronic drums from a Korg MS-20, Roland SH-09, Doepfer Dark Energy and Sequential Pro-One, with many samples per sound

name: Midnight Wurli
description: A Wurlitzer 200A played softly, sampled from the line out and a contact microphone that captures key clicks and pedal noise

name: Omni-84
description: The Suzuki Omnichord OM-84 sampled in full, from drums and bass to chords, keyboard and AutoStrum SonicStrings

name: Strykebrett
description: A sampled Logan String Melody II string synthesiser with ensemble, phaser, echo and reverb

name: StyloPoly
description: A Dubreq Stylophone S-1 made polyphonic, blending its three voices with noise, vibrato and filters

name: SubC
description: A Dreadbox Erebus v2 triangle oscillator run through saturation circuits and effects, in mono and stereo

name: Voltage Controlled Cassette Organ
description: A Korg CX-3 sampled through cassette tape, where wow, flutter and warble add organic movement to the drawbars
